description: Salted the water and left you in it.
name: Anne Shakespeare

description: Said the rye was in, and that he had helped turn it.
name: Edmund Shakespeare

description: Sent the loaf, with word of the assize, and was not there.
name: Hamnet Sadler

description: Sat the meal and did not speak.
name: Hamnet Shakespeare

description: Told you to leave the feet in the salt.
name: Joan Shakespeare

description: Said grace, asked about the horse, and kept the figure off the table.
name: John Shakespeare

description: Sat the meal and did not speak.
name: Judith Shakespeare

description: Looked at your ankles first, put the heel on your trencher, and did not speak.
name: Mary Shakespeare

description: Said the weather will hold, and nothing more.
name: Richard Shakespeare

description: Asked what the wheat was thin beside, and got no figure.
name: Susanna Shakespeare

description: Attended, and walked back to Henley Street.
name: William Shakespeare
